title: Jovial Flaky Italian Tomato Pasta
description: A peppery and flaky Italian dish featuring tomatoes, made with a mantecare emulsification method, and cooked in a wok to create a nostalgic and savory meal. This shojin-friendly recipe is perfect for those looking for a satisfying and comforting pasta dish.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti according to package instructions until al dente.
In a wok, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the garlic until fragrant.
Add the tomato puree to the wok and stir to combine with the garlic and oil.
Reduce heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Using a mantecare emulsification method, slowly add the grated grana padano cheese to the sauce, stirring constantly.
Add the cooked spaghetti to the wok and toss to combine with the sauce.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped fresh basil and serve immediately.
Let the pasta rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
